key_upgrades_over_c006: per-slot board (12 explicit slots) vs c006 averaged active + bag-mean bench
exact hand & discard multisets (set encoders) vs c006 bag-mean vectors
cross-option set encoder vs c006 independent per-option scoring
actual previous selected-option identity in history vs c006 index-only prev
zero-init id embedding residual for unseen legal cards vs c006 shared vocab embedding

current.result.justification: terminal outcome — excluded from inputs (label leakage); used only as the value-head training target

current.stadium.justification: presence flag in global; exact stadium card identity omitted (rare; the one strategically relevant stadium is derivable from options)

current.looking.justification: represented through LOOKING-area option cards when a look decision is live; transient otherwise

players[].bench.justification: per-slot board, 5 explicit slots each side, never averaged

players[].benchMax.justification: bench occupancy encoded via slot presence + global bench counts

pokemon.id.justification: card row -> semantic features + id embedding

pokemon.hp/maxHp.justification: hp_norm, maxhp_norm, damage_norm, remaining_frac per slot

pokemon.energyCards.justification: count per slot; exact special-energy card identities omitted (low leverage vs energy-type counts)

pokemon.tools.justification: count + has_tool per slot; exact tool identity omitted (rare)

players[me].hand.justification: exact multiset (12-slot set encoder + dup counts + playable mask)

players[].discard.justification: most-recent-N set encoder + per-card-type count summary; full ordered history beyond window compressed to counts

deck_composition/order.justification: hidden; teacher's remaining-count inference is a privileged label

players[].prize.justification: prize COUNTS represented; face-down identities hidden

select.option.justification: per-option dense features + 2 referenced card rows + set encoder

select.deck.justification: DECK-area options resolve to card rows

select.effect.justification: effect card identity omitted from global (Crispin reverse-scoring is captured through the option set); candidate future field

logs.justification: compressed to the actual previous-action identity in history; full event stream not sequence-encoded (stateless model; recurrence is future work)

search_begin_input.justification: opaque engine-state blob; used only for the branch-and-rollout capability probe, never featurized as a model input
